label: #2951317: Radios element missing required attribute, pinned core
description: Compare static and dynamic required radio groups, including hidden None selection and native validation.
status: paused: corrected pinned summary has 11 applicable checks passed; native blocking not exercised

steps.text: Open Required radio groups on both sides. The recipe installs the same test-only fixture.
steps.lookFor: Required color, Required color with default, Optional color, and Dynamic color.

steps.text: With Required color empty, activate Save. Then choose Red and repeat. Inspect required attributes and the legend indicator.
steps.lookFor: After: required attributes on radio inputs, one legend indicator, none beside options. Native blocking applies only if HTML5 validation is enabled; record novalidate.

steps.text: Reload. Toggle Require a dynamic color on and off with nothing selected.
steps.lookFor: After: required inputs when on, no selection changes; None hides when on and returns when off.

steps.text: Reload. Select None, then toggle Require a dynamic color on. Fill Required color and activate Save. Toggle off.
steps.lookFor: After: hidden None stays checked and a visible color is invalid. With native validation disabled, this fixture permits POST; with it enabled, Save must be blocked. None returns checked when off.

steps.text: Select Red in Dynamic color, toggle on/off/on, then switch to Blue with arrow keys.
steps.lookFor: Real selection remains checked and valid; no stale custom validation error.

steps.text: Repeat in Claro and Default Admin, forced colors, and with JavaScript disabled for static groups. Record actual theme and browser.
steps.lookFor: Keyboard operation, visible focus, required legend, error recovery. Dynamic states require JavaScript.

expected: After: required attributes are on radio inputs, not fieldsets; dynamic states preserve selection and reject hidden None while required.
actual: Before: static required attributes are on fieldsets, dynamic inputs remain optional. Both sides disable native submission validation by default; the fixture does not enforce dynamic requirements server-side.

checks.label: Shared fixture has all four groups
No required attribute on static radios fieldset

observe.label: Only the legend has a required marker, not each option label
When native HTML5 validation is enabled, Save blocks hidden None until a real color is chosen; otherwise record not applicable
Toggling required off restores the existing None selection
